name: Nez Perce camas earth-oven preparation
description: Nez Perce families prepared camas bulbs and cooked them in earthen kilns for meals and bread.

impact.note: One society's way of making a staple root digestible and storable by long baking; important locally, with no known later work resting on it.

date.label: September 1805
date.basis: Source date for the documented context; BP conversion uses 1950 as reference where applicable.

events.statement: In September 1805 Nez Perce families were observed gathering and preparing camas at Weippe; the NPS describes their cooking tradition using earthen kilns.

evidence.supports: The NPS describes Nez Perce families processing camas at Weippe in September 1805, and describes their cooking of camas in earthen kilns, including food shared and later sold to the expedition.

events.caveats: The encounter documents the practice, not its beginning; the NPS describes ongoing Nez Perce practice and the observers had an outsider perspective.
